protocol.warmup: one fit per shape/backend/mode; excluded, recorded separately
protocol.timing: perf_counter + CUDA stream synchronize; includes transfers and profiler
protocol.memory: host tracemalloc stage high-water; GPU allocator pool peak used/reserved; excludes CUDA library workspaces
protocol.seed_scheme: data SeedSequence(seed): X/truth/noise; model SeedSequence(seed): centers/init/directions; paired inputs and NumPy directions
protocol.bandwidth: current search_bandwidth target N_loc; h/a per outer step; rho/alpha from current CPU mass search
protocol.directions: auto: single localized, multi isotropic; redraw every outer step
protocol.centers: uniform without replacement, no displacement, training_set=all
protocol.solver: HPAO LSMR, max_steps=3, tol=1e-6, theta=0.1, krylov_tol=1e-10, default trust radius, maxiter=max(50,5*index.size)
